name: agent-app
description: AI agent application with tools, domain, and evaluation support
constitution_principles: Domain modules stay free of agent runtimes, frameworks, transport clients, and persistence-layer imports.
Agent orchestration composes tools and domain logic through explicit boundaries; business rules do not migrate into tools or runtime adapters.
Product code depends on ObservationProvider and EvaluationProvider abstractions only; observability and evaluation SDK imports stay inside src/observability/ and src/evaluation/ respectively.
Observability and evaluation providers are injected at the composition root; no agent or tool module resolves its own provider.

starter_rules.prevents: framework, runtime, or persistence leakage into domain modules
triggers: domain-layer file gains framework, transport, persistence, or agent-runtime import
agent-app plan or implementation collapses domain and tooling boundaries
starter_rules.rule: Keep `src/domain/` framework-independent. Runtime SDKs, web frameworks, database clients, and transport libraries belong in tools or adapters, not in domain code.
starter_rules.detection_pattern: Review edits under `src/domain/` for imports such as FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, OpenHarness, HTTP clients, or database drivers.
starter_rules.correct_pattern: Domain modules expose pure business logic. Tooling and runtime integrations live in `src/tools/` or an adapter/infrastructure layer.

starter_rules.prevents: observability or DeepEval SDK leakage into agent, tool, domain, or test helper modules
triggers: agent, tool, or domain file gains a direct observability SDK import such as `from opentelemetry` or `from langfuse`, or a `from deepeval` import
test helper outside src/evaluation/ imports deepeval directly
starter_rules.rule: Keep observability SDK imports in the selected provider file under `src/observability/` and DeepEval imports in `src/evaluation/deepeval.py`. All other modules depend on the Protocol interfaces in `src/observability/base.py` and `src/evaluation/base.py`.
starter_rules.detection_pattern: Review edits under `src/agents/`, `src/tools/`, `src/domain/`, and `tests/` for `from opentelemetry`, `from langfuse`, or `from deepeval` imports.
starter_rules.correct_pattern: Agent and tool constructors accept ObservationProvider and EvaluationProvider types. Provider instances are created at the composition root and injected.
